help.zh: 恢复原版上限或降低倍率可能丢失超量堆叠的物品数量。请在 Mod 仍启用时把大堆拆回目标上限，并实际保存、读档核实后再关闭或卸载。本包不提供自动迁移。
help.en: Reducing stack limits can truncate oversized stacks. While this mod is enabled, split stacks to the target limits, save and reload to verify before disabling or uninstalling. No automatic save migration is provided.
